title: Local finite-model comparison for derived Hom sheaves
statement: For a scheme X, a finite commutative ring B, a bounded derived etale B-module sheaf A whose cohomology sheaves are finite locally constant, and a bounded-below target D, if A is etale locally represented by bounded complexes of finite B-modules, then the canonical derived Hom sheaf comparison is an isomorphism.

proof.text: On each cover member choose the bounded finite coefficient model. The bounded-free RHom model identifies pullback of the Hom complex with the Hom complex of pullbacks; K-injective derived sections identify degree-zero classes, and the resulting local inverses agree on overlaps because they are induced by pullback of actual derived maps. Descent gives the global canonical isomorphism.

mathlib_searches.query: bounded finite free RHom model and exact pullback derived Hom sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: No exact match; project local theorem is used.

theorem derivedHomSheafComparison_isIso_of_finite_local_models
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (A D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (hD : (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
      (C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))).plus D)
    (hmodels : ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) ℤ,
        (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Finite (E.X n)) ∧ Nonempty
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (𝒰.f i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj A ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (((constantSheaf (𝒰.X i).smallEtaleTopology
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E))) :
    IsIso (derivedHomSheafComparison X B A D)
